source_description_html:
Motorcycle touring boots made of perforated fabric and waterproof Gore-Tex® membrane, which makes them ideal for four-season use in all weather conditions.

Featuring a modern and understated design, Freeland 2 Gore-Tex® are boots distinguished by great climate comfort, lightness and ease of use, without neglecting functionality and research of technical details.

source_description_html:
Carve Master 4 Gore-Tex Jacket is the latest evolution of the Dainese sport touring motorcycle jacket. Ideal for traveling even in low temperatures, in total comfort and with maximum performance. The new waterproof GORE-TEX® ePE membrane guarantees waterproofing as it acts like a rain shield, as well as excellent breathability. The stretch construction follows the body’s movements every time you shift on the saddle owing to the large inserts in Mugello stretch fabric – soft and lightweight yet resistant. Featuring a custom fit and increased softness compared to the previous version, for maximum comfort while riding also owing to the extensive adjustment systems on hips, arms, wrists and neck.

The removable thermal lining allows you to manage body heat, for superior comfort even when traveling in the coldest season. Great versatility of use and ventilation systems activated with just one hand on chest, back and sleeves.

With AA class certification and the highest Dainese safety standards guaranteed by the ventilated Pro-Armor Level 2 soft protectors – inspired by the geometrical shapes of natural fractals – on elbows and shoulders, and PU/plastic shoulder plates. Pockets designed to accommodate the Pro-Armor back protector and chest protector, and compatibility with the Dainese Smart Air airbag with D-air® technology help increase the wearer’s protection.

Featuring functional details such as two external waterproof pockets, a zipper for fastening to the pants and a card pocket on the wrist, CARVE MASTER 4 is the iconic jacket with a sporty look that blends technology, superior quality and practicality for endless journeys with maximum comfort and performance.

Ideally paired with the Carve Master 4 Gore-Tex Pants to complete your outfit, or a couples’ outfit.

source_description_html:
Full Metal 7 Gloves are motorcycle gloves created to guarantee maximum performance and protection. Made of durable goatskin leather, these gloves feature protective Pro-Tek titanium inserts on the knuckles and Kevlar inserts on palm, fingers and back, as well as reinforcement on the little finger and scaphoid.

Full Metal 7 Gloves are designed to protect knuckles and the back of the hand, ensuring extremely high impact protection, excellent sliding owing to the titanium and exceptional levels of comfort and hand mobility owing to their stretch co-injected joint.

These professional gloves, worn by MotoGP™ champions, maximize comfort, lightness and riding sensitivity, allowing riders to fully focus on their performance. The pre-curved construction of sleeve and fingers, integrated stretch inserts on the back, fingers and base of the fourchettes, and the new knuckle contouring all guarantee high levels of comfort and ergonomics while also enhancing riding precision.

The perfect blend of iconic design and Dainese’s high technological standards, Full Metal 7 Gloves embody the latest evolution of top-of-the-range racing gloves, with additional Level 2 certification.

Full Metal 7 Gloves’ construction ensures a perfect connection to Dainese’s racing suits.

The Dainese Air Frame D1 Jacket incorporates all the necessary features for a performance summer riding jacket, but with the fit and finish that only Dainese can provide. Monstrous areas of mesh punctuate the QuickDry Fabric chassis for maximum airflow when the weather gets unbearable. Composite protectors are standard in the sleeves and there is a pocket for an optional back protector as well (sold separately). A practical windproof liner can be installed for those chilly morning rides and pulled back out quickly when you know the day is going to heat up. Thoughtful attention to detail such as the Anti-Floating Sleeve System and soft inserts at the wrists and neck where the jacket comes into contact with the rider’s skin reflect Dainese’s experience and expertise, attesting to the quality and value of the Dainese Air Frame D1 Jacket.

description: New top-of-the-range Dainese sports shoes. Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.
source_description_html:
New top-of-the-range Dainese sports shoes.

Distinguished by a sporty and edgy look, the Superya Shoes are designed for the most demanding motorcycle riders looking for comfort and ergonomics on and off the saddle, but without compromising on protection.

The microfiber upper with graphics purely inspired by racing features micro-perforations to ensure maximum breathability even during the hottest days. Stretch inserts on the back and on the instep to facilitate entry provide both thermal comfort and ease of fit.

Advanced protection is guaranteed by the magnesium sliders on the toe and in the malleolus area as well as by the reinforcements on the heel – technological details that recall the protective standards of Dainese motorcycle boots while guaranteeing the comfort and versatility of shoes.

Functionality and practicality are maximized by technical elements such as the Quicklace System, the integration of a lace compartment on the tongue and the Velcro fastening with a protective thermoformed plastic reinforcement insert for the malleolus area.

The OrthoLite® insole and the asymmetric Groundtrax® racing sole guarantee maximum ergonomics and riding sensitivity.

description: Long goatskin leather motorcycle sport gloves designed for hand protection, high riding sensitivity, mobility and extreme comfort. Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.
source_description_html:
Long goatskin leather motorcycle sport gloves designed for hand protection, high riding sensitivity, mobility and extreme comfort.
Stretch construction on back, palm and fingers promotes movement, mobility and flexion of the fingers. Maximum comfort and riding sensitivity owing to the fourchette construction, the seams and the leather palm reinforced with goatskin leather.

Safety is ensured by the new rigid, ergonomic carbon knuckle and padding on palm, little finger, thumb, ulna and radius as well as by plastic reinforcement on index, middle and ring fingers.

Perforation on the fingers promotes ventilation, so that the gloves can be worn during hot days. The long thermoformed sleeve features a comfortable opening for easy fit. The Dainese smart touch insert on the index finger adds daily functionality, so you can use smartphones and touch-screen GPS systems without the need to take off the glove.

For those seeking protection without compromising on maximum comfort and mobility while riding.

source_description_html:
Made of microfiber and D-Stone™ fabric with high-grip TPU D-Axial system, these racing boots, inspired by the top-of-the-range Dainese Axial 2, guarantee maximum comfort and high standards of protection while maintaining a sporty and attractive design, enhanced by the integration of translucent plastic inserts giving a glimpse of the underlying shock absorbers.

The elasticated D-Stone™ fabric ensures maximum resistance and ease of fit. The magnesium sliders on toe and heel are replaceable, a solution that also allows the zipper to be replaced if it breaks. The highest levels of shin and heel safety are ensured by the D-Axial system, which allows for better shock absorption in the event of a fall and also features an external graphic pattern that recalls the Pro-Amor 2. The innovative Groundtrax® asymmetric soles with differentiated gear and brake areas are designed to guarantee grip and heat resistance.

A true champion of lightness and performance, to express yourself to the fullest both on the road and on the track.
